# PlatiGemini 1200 Watt 80 PLUS Platinum Fully Modular ATX 3.1 & ATX12VO Power Supply

 ▪ Red Dot Design Award 2024 Winner ▪ Integrated with Both Intel ATX 3.1 and ATX12VO Standards ▪ Fully Modular 80 PLUS® Platinum Certified ▪ PCIe 5.1 with 600W 12V-2x6 Cable ▪ Up to 235% Power Excursion ▪ Industrial-Grade 100% Japanese Capacitors ▪ Invest in Longevity with Dust-Free Rotation Tech. & D.F. The PlatiGemini is an 80 PLUS ® PLATINUM efficiency certified power supply supporting both Intel ATX 3.1 and ATX12VO standards simultaneously in a single model. The dual-standard ensures a smooth transition to the next generation of computing with a significant improvement in power efficiency and reduction in power consumption under low load. The PlatiGemini is designed to satisfy a variety of applications and industry fields including enterprises with high power consumption needs and creators in filmmaking, video editing, photography, game design, animation, and product design. To meet evolving needs from the present to the future, the PlatiGemini is packed with ENERMAX's cutting-edge technology, seamlessly integrating Intel ATX 3.1 and ATX12VO standards that painlessly switch between different specifications with motherboards compliant. It also boasts a native 600W 12V-2x6 cable, tailored to meet the evolving demands of high-end graphics cards both now and in the future.

...

## 80 PLUS ® PLATINUM EFFICIENCY

The PlatiGemini is 80 PLUS ® PLATINUM certified with up to 94% efficiency on a typical load and up to 76% efficiency at 2% load. ENERMAX is devoted to creating a greener environment by building a high-efficiency power supply with less energy waste, and the PlatiGemini is competent for delivering unprecedented high-performance conversion while reducing unnecessary heat to improve reliability and longer lifespan for your system.

# TOP-TIER PERFORMANCE

UP TO 235% POWER EXCURSION

Accommodating power surges of up to 235%, the PlatiGemini is capable of handling over 2.35X its rated wattage for short durations. This feature meets the power demands of high-end graphics cards, ensuring system stability by preventing power fluctuations and potential PC crashes.

100% JAPANESE CAPACITORS

The PlatiGemini incorporates 100% industrial-grade Japanese capacitors with high-quality materials and manufacturing processes, ensuring stable and consistent performance.

6-POLE MOTOR 

Equipped with a 6-pole motor with a 3-phase fan to provide minimal vibration, low power consumption, and an exceptionally smooth operation with low noise.

INDUSTRIAL DUAL-BALL BEARING

For users looking to put in a high-end, power-demanding GPU, please plug in the 12+4P / 6P / 6+2P PCIe connector(s) from your ENERMAX power supply to the GPU properly. This will prevent the motherboard from overloading and possibly causing any damage to your system, including your ENERMAX power supply. Once this occurs, it will be treated as improper system configuration, and any damage caused to the power supply, as a result, will not be covered under ENERMAX manufacturer’s warranty.
